author: master-designer
status: PROPOSAL. Not binding. Nothing here changes docs/house-plan.*, the Bible, skeleton-spec or slots files. Every geometry delta and every camera change needs user approval. All 'est' values are hand pinhole estimates (24 mm equations of house-plan.json, +-0.02); no tool run. Clay validates before any decision.
trigger_user_feedback_verbatim: מרפרוף שלי בתמונות, זה לא נראה תמונות בצילום של מגזין, זה נראה יותר מעין של מביט, או כאילו מצילום אקראי, ואין התייחסות מלאה לסגנון ולעוצמה שאנחנו מחפשים בעצם להציג כל חדר לדעתי. הייתי שמח שזה יהיה בקומפוזיציה הרבה הרבה יותר מוקפדת לכל אחד מהחדרים ושכל תמונה תהיה וואו בעצם, שוב, כמו תמונה ממגזין ולא תמונה של צופה.
scope: All master frames except the approved living room (M0 untouched; E0 end frame untouched).

conventions.axes_and_yaw: As docs/house-plan.json: f = (-sin yaw, -cos yaw), r = (cos yaw, -sin yaw), yaw measured left from -Y.
conventions.projection_24mm: u = u0 + 0.6667 x/d ; v = v0 + 1.1852 (Hc - Z)/d. Hc is the camera height of that option (not always 1.20).
conventions.lens: 24 mm everywhere (entry/arrival lens is fixed at 24 by the Bible; no creep on arrivals).

magazine_standard_v2: S1 One named hero per frame, on a third (u 0.30-0.36 / 0.64-0.70) or dead centre in a truly symmetric frame (u0 0.50). Never 'almost centre' (0.45-0.58 for an asymmetric hero).
S2 Distance: >= 3.0 m from camera to the hero wall (bath >= 2.8). Get it by shooting from the threshold or from the far wall, not by a wider lens.
S3 Height: 1.20 public spaces (hall, corridor; living stays), 1.10 dining and work, 1.05 master, 1.00 kids ('child's eye'). Bath 1.15. Verticals plumb, framing by shift only.
S4 Window: in frame on the left, either whole with >= 0.03 to every edge or cut decisively (>= 15% of its width). Never a near-tangent. Window <= 30% of frame width.
S5 Three depth layers: foreground (low object, decisively cut), mid (hero), background (architecture, window, glimpse into the next room).
S6 One readable light direction with a visible gradient on the hero wall. Dark spaces get daylight from above (opal roof light), not exposure.
S7 Negative space: >= 25% of the frame is calm wall or floor.
S8 Edges: no object or architectural line within 0.02 of an edge unless cut by >= 15%; door jambs out by >= 0.02 or used on purpose.
S9 Every room gets one architectural 'bone' that carries the wow (portal, roof light, built-in, panelling, alcove, limestone + fluted light).

global_rule_changes_needing_approval.what: Camera height per room (S3) instead of 1.20 everywhere; Bible 'camera ~120' becomes 'living/hall/corridor 120; other rooms 100-115'. Arrivals merge the pedestal into the last straight vector (allowed by the motion grammar).
u0 0.50 for symmetric one-point frames (MB0', W0', C0 already).
Slider through a doorway ('wall wipe') used as an arrival shot (T-CBoy, T-CBath, T-CGirl, T-HW, T-CM). Slider is already an allowed move; new is using it through a door with >= 0.15 jamb clearance.

Opal roof lights (hall, corridor) as a daylight source. Diffusing glazing in a light well, no sun patch possible; they cast soft top light only. HC6 extended: 'windows lighting frames are north/east or opal roof lights'.
H0 (site opening frame, U1) yaw 25 -> 12 and E0 prefixed by a 13 deg pan. Only if H-B is chosen.
New rail station S1' at Y 13.00 (boy and bath); S1 (13.60) retired.

clay_instructions_motion_agent.output: assets/blockout/house/framing/<room>/<option>/{clay.png, overlay.png, selfcheck.json} + assets/blockout/house/framing/compare.jpg (current vs A vs B per room, same size, thirds grid in a separate overlay row)
clay_instructions_motion_agent.build: Add '--framing <option-id>' to build_house.py that applies the geometry_deltas of that option on top of house-plan 1.0; no flag = identical to today's clays.
clay_instructions_motion_agent.light: Sky only, as today, PLUS the roof lights of the option (opal = large diffuse emitter in the well). For hall and corridor also render a second pass with the planned practicals at 2700K so the darkness is not misjudged.
clay_instructions_motion_agent.proxies: Use the layout of each option (bed, desk, console, bench, vanity, mirror plane). Mirror (B-A, B-B): render a reflection-only pass and list every object seen in it.
clay_instructions_motion_agent.sweeps: Render the 'sweep' ranges in cameras_for_clay as a contact strip (5 frames), so I pick the exact value from pixels.
clay_instructions_motion_agent.report: Every est value vs measured (|delta| > 0.02 flagged), every tangent < 0.02 between large items or with an edge, jamb clearance of every new transition (>= 0.15), mean frame L.
clay_instructions_motion_agent.fix_policy: Do not move anything to fix a failure. Report; I close it.

acceptance_checks: F1 hero on a third (0.30-0.36 / 0.64-0.70) or at 0.50 +-0.01 in u0 0.50 frames
F2 window per S4: whole with >= 0.03 to every edge, or cut >= 15% of its width
F3 no edge tangent < 0.02 (objects, door jambs, window heads, corner lines)
F5 camera-to-hero-wall distance as listed (>= 3.0, bath >= 2.8)
F7 hall and corridor mean L >= 95 with roof light (sky only), wall gradient readable
F8 U6: mirror reflection shows only wall (no product, fixture, window, camera, lamp)
F9 every new transition: jamb clearance >= 0.15, last frame identical to the master camera, U10 play time
